table.retrieve:
SELECT
	invcode	=	dbo.PrLedger.PrInvCode, 
	date		= 	dbo.PrLedger.date,
	flatdisc	=	dbo.PrLedger.flatdisc,
	salestax    = dbo.PrLedger.salestax,
	misccharges = dbo.PrLedger.misccharges,
	invdiscperc = dbo.PrLedger.discperc,
	invgstperc1 = dbo.PrLedger.invgstperc1,
	doctype = Case dbo.PrLedger.PrCatCode When 4 Then 'Cash' When 5 Then 'Credit' Else 'Opening' End,
	dbo.accounts.name,
	amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.PrDetail.looseqty * dbo.PrDetail.Prprice), 2),
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.PrDetail.looseqty  * dbo.PrDetail.Prprice * (dbo.PrDetail.discperc * .01) ), 2),
	invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( (dbo.PrDetail.looseqty  ) * dbo.PrDetail.PrPrice * (1 - (dbo.PrDetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.PrLedger.discperc /100), 2),
	itemsalestax = Sum (Round ( (dbo.PrDetail.looseqty + dbo.PrDetail.bonusqty) * dbo.PrDetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( dbo.PrDetail.looseqty * dbo.PrDetail.PrPrice * (1 - dbo.PrDetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.PrDetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
	remarks = dbo.PrLedger.remarks	,
	posted=max(prledger.posted)

FROM dbo.PrLedger, 
         dbo.PrDetail,   
         dbo.accounts  

WHERE dbo.PrLedger.PrInvCode = dbo.PrDetail.PrInvCode and  
 	(dbo.PrLedger.SuppCode >= ( Case :al_SuppCode When 0 Then 0 Else :al_SuppCode End) and 
	dbo.PrLedger.SuppCode  <= ( Case :al_SuppCode When 0 THEN (Select max(SuppCode) From Supplier) Else :al_SuppCode End )) and
	dbo.PrLedger.PrCatCode IN (4,5,6) and
   dbo.PrLedger.SuppCode = dbo.accounts.acccode and	
	dbo.PrLedger.date between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate

GROUP BY dbo.PrLedger.misccharges,   
         dbo.PrLedger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.PrLedger.date,   
         dbo.PrLedger.PrInvCode,   
	 dbo.PrLedger.discperc,  
	 dbo.PrLedger.salestax, 
	 dbo.PrLedger.prcatcode, 
	 dbo.accounts.name,
	 dbo.PrLedger.invgstperc1,	
	 dbo.PrLedger.remarks 
         
ORDER BY dbo.PrLedger.PrInvCode ASC,   
         dbo.PrLedger.date ASC
